Patch 0.24.4 (Party dungeon state now reads clearly before you click in)

  • Party run state is explicit: The Dungeon Guide now spells out whether the party is starting a fresh run, continuing a live run, or sitting on an empty instance that is about to collapse.
  • Leader ownership is visible: Leader-only reset ownership is now explicit in the menu, while non-leaders are told they can only continue the current party instance.
  • Buttons read like group actions: Enter and reset buttons now read like party actions instead of generic solo-instance verbs.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for party instance state messaging, continue-versus-start labeling, leader-only reset controls, and 0.24.4 version presentation.

Patch 0.24.3 (The Dungeon Guide now shows why another run is worth doing)

  • Visible rerun ladder: The Dungeon Guide now surfaces a live repeat-run ladder tied to your accepted daily dungeon boss quests instead of leaving that incentive buried in the quest list.
  • Selected route matters: The ladder updates by selected dungeon and difficulty so players can see which reruns are still paying the strongest daily XP before they commit to the next run.
  • 0.24 reward-ladder pass: This gives max-level dungeon play a visible reward ladder before the later party-flow hardening pass.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for dungeon menu repeat-run ladder rendering, selected dungeon/difficulty daily quest visibility, and 0.24.3 version presentation.

Patch 0.24.2 (Heroic and Mythic now read like distinct endgame reward lanes)

  • Endgame reward identity: Heroic bosses now guarantee a bonus gem drop, while Mythic bosses guarantee both a bonus gem and a unique-effect item on top of the normal boss payout.
  • Difficulty reads better up front: The dungeon menu now explains each difficulty as a distinct endgame lane instead of only listing stat multipliers, so Heroic reads like a gem chase and Mythic reads like a capstone build-defining push.
  • Reward summary tells the truth: Boss reward summaries now surface the exact Heroic or Mythic bonus rule that paid out on the kill, matching the authoritative server reward logic.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for endgame difficulty reward notes, guaranteed Mythic unique-effect gear, dungeon menu identity copy, and 0.24.2 version presentation.

Patch 0.24.1 (Long dungeon runs now cadence reward pockets and pressure spikes more deliberately)

  • Long-run cadence pass: Longer multi-boss dungeons can now stage a second chest pocket and a second elite ambush deeper in the run instead of spending the entire dungeon line on only one early reward and one early spike.
  • Shrine stays late: The shrine beat still anchors the deep pre-boss reset, so repeated reward and pressure beats do not consume the final recovery window.
  • 0.24 depth continues: This is the first real encounter-cadence pass on top of the new room-role metadata, giving longer runs more authored momentum before the Heroic/Mythic identity slice.
  • Regression coverage: Added server and client regression coverage for expanded long-run hook distribution, repeated reward/ambush beats, and preserved late-shrine recovery pacing.

Patch 0.24.0 (Dungeon room roles now read like a pacing plan instead of isolated markers)

  • Canonical room roles: Dungeon room state now tags rooms with shared roles like travel, reward, recovery, elite, event, and boss so route surfaces can read from one pacing model instead of scattered hook checks.
  • Pacing labels on route guidance: The journal, hovered dungeon portals, minimap markers, and world-map active dungeon marker now surface cadence reads like Payoff, Reset, Spike, Pressure, and Climax alongside the next beat.
  • 0.24 begins: This starts the dungeon-depth line by making room-role metadata explicit and reusable before the follow-up cadence tuning, endgame identity, and rerun-incentive slices.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for normalized dungeon room metadata, cadence-aware route guidance, entrance hints, minimap overlays, and world-map beat previews.

Patch 0.23.4 (Reward moments now land harder at the end of the 0.23 line)

  • Stronger reward payoff: Boss-kill and room-clear reward callouts now lead with a payoff read instead of only a ledger, so dungeon clears feel more like a win and less like a receipt.
  • Better loot pulse: Reward chat now surfaces short punchier lines like boss down, build drops secured, and elite-room payoff before falling back to raw currency and loot counts.
  • 0.23 closeout: This closes the `0.23` line with class identity, loot readability, buildcraft coherence, and stronger reward presentation before the roadmap shifts toward dungeon/endgame depth in `0.24`.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for stronger reward/chat payoff messaging, updated room-clear summaries, and 0.23.4 version presentation.

Patch 0.23.3 (Forge and respec now explain the buildcraft order more clearly)

  • Forge action order: The Forge now spells out the buildcraft sequence up front: use Shards first to test likely keepers, invest Hearts once a piece stays equipped, then open sockets and commit gems.
  • Upgrade affordability: Upgrade previews now show current Shard availability and disable actions you cannot afford yet, matching the clearer material checks already present on Potency and Sockets.
  • Respec intent clarity: The Talent Master now explains when to reset talents, when to reset skills, and when a full rebuild makes sense, instead of only listing three gold costs.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for forge upgrade material visibility, forge-to-respec handoff, richer respec explanations, and 0.23.3 version presentation.

Patch 0.23.2 (Loot decisions now read faster from the tooltip itself)

  • Quick gear read: Starter equippable tooltips now call out open-slot items, likely upgrades, likely weaker drops, and mixed-signal sidegrades before you fully parse every stat line.
  • Visible compare hint: Desktop item tooltips now explicitly tell you when to hold Shift and which equipped item you are comparing against, including auto-slot ring and trinket cases.
  • 0.23 focus continues: This keeps the early `0.23` buildcraft pass centered on loot and item-decision readability before the deeper forge and respec coherence work.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for starter equip-read tooltip guidance, compare-target hints, and 0.23.2 version presentation.

Patch 0.23.1 (Branch roles now explain how each spec actually plays)

  • Actionable branch identity: Skill Tree branches now show role tags plus quick "Wants" and "Excels at" summaries, so spec choice reads like a build direction instead of only a list of node names.
  • Stronger branch comparison: Tank Core vs Bruiser, Burst Assassin vs Throw Specialist, AoE Caster vs Boss Caster, and the other branch splits now read more clearly at a glance.
  • 0.23 focus continues: This keeps the early `0.23` effort focused on class/spec fantasy and branch differentiation before the deeper loot/buildcraft passes.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for branch-role identity cards and 0.23.1 version presentation.

Patch 0.23.0 (Class identity and branch fantasy now read more clearly)

  • Class-select identity: Character creation and first-login messaging now push players toward picking a combat fantasy, not just the safest starter pick.
  • Skill Tree identity: Skill Tree now leads with a class identity summary and branch-role summaries so each path reads like a distinct combat role before you unlock deeper nodes.
  • 0.22 closure: `0.22` is now closed for planned implementation work, and this is the first `0.23` slice focused on class/spec fantasy presentation.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for skill-tree identity copy, updated first-login guidance, and 0.23.0 version presentation.
